statements.text: In grounding by subsumption a fact is nothing over and above another because it is one aspect of it, as a red experience is an aspect of a total visual experience, or a region of space an aspect of space as a whole. Unlike grounding by truthmaking, it does not demote the aspect to a shadow of language.

sources.quote: In each case, the reality of the whole subsumes the reality of the aspect.
accounting for nothing-over-and-aboveness via grounding by subsumption need not involve a commitment to a deflationary view of non-fundamental entities or properties
